tagline: Building Dreams. Developing Lands. Redefining Spaces.
description: One accountable team for construction, title and MahaRERA paperwork, legal and finance, from the first committee meeting to handing over the keys.

rightSide.overlayText: crafting modern skyline rooted in ancient wisdom

h1: Redevelopment and construction for Nashik housing societies
steps: Members pass the resolution in a general body meeting
Select a developer through an open tender
Sign and register the development agreement
NMC building permission and MahaRERA registration
Vacate, demolish and build, with regular updates
Occupancy certificate and handover of new flats
